description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing a test tree structure in a testing framework, including types for test items, groups, and methods for filtering, sorting, and manipulating the test tree.

classes.name: TestTree
classes.description: Class for constructing and managing a hierarchical test tree, including filtering, sorting, and flattening functionalities.

methods.name: sortAndPropagateStatus
methods.description: Sorts children of a tree item and updates its status based on children's statuses.

methods.name: collectTestIds
methods.description: Collects all test IDs and file locations from a tree item.
